role: Renderer-agnostic cloud / weather state for Cloud Prototype v0. Describes WHERE clouds are and what kind they are; never how they are drawn. tools/lookdev/clouds/build_clouds.py turns it into a cell list (any renderer: volumetric, impostor cards, mobile sprites, in-cloud fog) and a tileable weather map (the UE volumetric renderer's input). Future gameplay / weather simulation should read or write this state, not renderer settings.
frame: Xinyi ENU metres (origin = cities/taipei/city.yaml enu_origin; x east, y north, z up above mean sea level)
notes: Northern-Taiwan humid fair-weather day: shallow cumulus with bases ~1.25 km, a few towers to ~3 km, favouring the hills (Yangmingshan, Nangang / Four Beasts) over the basin floor as afternoon orographic cumulus do; a compact broken stratocumulus deck sits over the northern mountains (~21 km N), visible as a distant deck rather than an overcast above Xinyi.

omitted_archetypes.thin_high_cloud: not in v0: a cirrus deck at 8-10 km would need its own volumetric layer (cost) or a sky-dome card; deferred

wind_note: static in v0 (captures are stills); renderers may advect the map by wind * time
